insights.name: 同一个问题的完成与行动
insights.description: 按request_id关联去重，最近30天。缓存路径不要求API事件。行动=查看日期或分享API成功；无完成回执不是自动判定失败。非规范指标。

source.query:
SELECT if(cached = 1, '缓存', '网络') AS path, count() AS submitted_attempts, countIf(admitted = 1) AS api_admitted, countIf(completed = 1) AS api_completed, countIf(received = 1) AS received_attempts, countIf(viewed = 1) AS viewed_attempts, countIf(viewed = 1 AND action = 1) AS acted, countIf(failed = 1) AS failure_receipt FROM (SELECT properties.request_id AS request_id,
 max(event = 'ai_query_submitted') AS submitted, max(event = 'ai_query_started') AS admitted,
 max(event = 'ai_query_completed') AS completed, max(event = 'ai_response_received') AS received,
 max(event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS viewed, max(event = 'ai_cache_hit') AS cached,
 max(event = 'ai_query_error' OR event = 'ai_query_failed' OR event = 'ai_query_blocked' OR event = 'ai_query_rejected') AS failed,
 max(event = 'ai_result_day_opened' OR (event = 'ai_answer_share_outcome' AND properties.outcome = 'completed')) AS action,
 argMaxIf(properties.result_kind, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS kind,
 argMaxIf(properties.level, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS level,
 argMaxIf(properties.fallback, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS fallback,
 argMaxIf(properties.assumption_count, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS assumption_count,
 argMaxIf(properties.rating, timestamp, event = 'ai_feedback_stored') AS rating,
 argMaxIf(properties.missing, timestamp, event = 'ai_clarification_shown') AS missing,
 argMaxIf(properties.parent_request_id, timestamp, event = 'ai_query_submitted') AS parent_id
 FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = false AND properties.analytics_version >= 2 AND (coalesce(properties.$session_id, '') NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = true AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties.$session_id))
 AND event IN ('ai_query_submitted','ai_query_started','ai_query_completed','ai_response_received','ai_result_viewed','ai_cache_hit','ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_blocked','ai_query_rejected','ai_result_day_opened','ai_answer_share_outcome','ai_feedback_stored','ai_clarification_shown')
 AND properties.request_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY request_id) WHERE submitted = 1 GROUP BY path LIMIT 10

 max(event = 'ai_query_submitted') AS submitted, max(event = 'ai_query_started') AS admitted,
 max(event = 'ai_query_completed') AS completed, max(event = 'ai_response_received') AS received,
 max(event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS viewed, max(event = 'ai_cache_hit') AS cached,
 max(event = 'ai_query_error' OR event = 'ai_query_failed' OR event = 'ai_query_blocked' OR event = 'ai_query_rejected') AS failed,
 max(event = 'ai_result_day_opened' OR (event = 'ai_answer_share_outcome' AND properties.outcome = 'completed')) AS action,
 argMaxIf(properties.result_kind, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS kind,
 argMaxIf(properties.level, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS level,
 argMaxIf(properties.fallback, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS fallback,
 argMaxIf(properties.assumption_count, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS assumption_count,
 argMaxIf(properties.rating, timestamp, event = 'ai_feedback_stored') AS rating,
 argMaxIf(properties.missing, timestamp, event = 'ai_clarification_shown') AS missing,
 argMaxIf(properties.parent_request_id, timestamp, event = 'ai_query_submitted') AS parent_id
 FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = false AND properties.analytics_version >= 2 AND (coalesce(properties.$session_id, '') NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = true AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties.$session_id))
 AND event IN ('ai_query_submitted','ai_query_started','ai_query_completed','ai_response_received','ai_result_viewed','ai_cache_hit','ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_blocked','ai_query_rejected','ai_result_day_opened','ai_answer_share_outcome','ai_feedback_stored','ai_clarification_shown')
 AND properties.request_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY request_id) WHERE viewed = 1 GROUP BY kind, level, fallback LIMIT 30

insights.name: 澄清后是否继续并看到新回答
insights.description: parent_request_id关联已展示的澄清与后续问题；同一父问题去重。日期和交通澄清分开。最近30天。非规范指标。

source.query:
WITH attempts AS (SELECT properties.request_id AS request_id,
 max(event = 'ai_query_submitted') AS submitted, max(event = 'ai_query_started') AS admitted,
 max(event = 'ai_query_completed') AS completed, max(event = 'ai_response_received') AS received,
 max(event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS viewed, max(event = 'ai_cache_hit') AS cached,
 max(event = 'ai_query_error' OR event = 'ai_query_failed' OR event = 'ai_query_blocked' OR event = 'ai_query_rejected') AS failed,
 max(event = 'ai_result_day_opened' OR (event = 'ai_answer_share_outcome' AND properties.outcome = 'completed')) AS action,
 argMaxIf(properties.result_kind, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS kind,
 argMaxIf(properties.level, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS level,
 argMaxIf(properties.fallback, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS fallback,
 argMaxIf(properties.assumption_count, timestamp, event = 'ai_result_viewed') AS assumption_count,
 argMaxIf(properties.rating, timestamp, event = 'ai_feedback_stored') AS rating,
 argMaxIf(properties.missing, timestamp, event = 'ai_clarification_shown') AS missing,
 argMaxIf(properties.parent_request_id, timestamp, event = 'ai_query_submitted') AS parent_id
 FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = false AND properties.analytics_version >= 2 AND (coalesce(properties.$session_id, '') NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = true AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties.$session_id))
 AND event IN ('ai_query_submitted','ai_query_started','ai_query_completed','ai_response_received','ai_result_viewed','ai_cache_hit','ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_blocked','ai_query_rejected','ai_result_day_opened','ai_answer_share_outcome','ai_feedback_stored','ai_clarification_shown')
 AND properties.request_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY request_id) SELECT p.missing AS missing, count() AS clarifications_viewed, countIf(coalesce(c.children, 0) > 0) AS parents_continued, countIf(coalesce(c.child_viewed, 0) > 0) AS parents_with_child_viewed FROM attempts p LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_id, countIf(submitted = 1) AS children, max(viewed) AS child_viewed FROM attempts WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_id != '' GROUP BY parent_id) c ON p.request_id = c.parent_id WHERE p.kind = 'clarify' AND p.viewed = 1 GROUP BY p.missing LIMIT 10

insights.name: AI 每次请求结果（去重）
insights.description: 固定滚动30天。按request_id去重；成功响应优先；浏览器/服务端同错只算一次。缺最终事件为unresolved，非失败。不展示原文。

source.query:
SELECT multiIf(received>0 AND cached>0,'CACHE_RECEIVED', received>0,'NETWORK_RECEIVED',limited>0,'CLIENT_LIMITED',rejected>0,'SERVER_REJECTED',failed>0,'FAILED_WITHOUT_RESPONSE',cancelled>0,'CANCELLED',completed>0,'SERVER_COMPLETED_NO_RECEIPT','NO_TERMINAL_TELEMETRY') AS outcome, if(received>0,'',coalesce(code,'')) AS error_reason, count() AS attempts, countIf(viewed>0) AS viewed_attempts FROM (SELECT properties.request_id AS rid,
max(event='ai_query_submitted') AS submitted,
max(event='ai_response_received') AS received,
max(event='ai_result_viewed') AS viewed,
max(event='ai_cache_hit') AS cached,
max(event='ai_query_completed') AS completed,
max(event='ai_query_error' OR event='ai_query_failed') AS failed,
max(event='ai_query_rejected') AS rejected,
max(event='ai_query_blocked') AS limited,
max(event='ai_query_cancelled') AS cancelled,
argMaxIf(properties.error_code,timestamp,event IN ('ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_rejected','ai_query_blocked')) AS code
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = false AND properties.analytics_version > 1 AND coalesce(properties.$session_id, '') NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = true AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties.$session_id) AND properties.request_id IS NOT NULL AND event IN ('ai_query_submitted','ai_response_received','ai_result_viewed','ai_cache_hit','ai_query_completed','ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_rejected','ai_query_blocked','ai_query_cancelled')
GROUP BY rid) WHERE submitted>0 GROUP BY outcome,error_reason ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: AI 失败后续问是否恢复（关联请求）
insights.description: 固定滚动30天。ai_retry_submitted关联上次失败的parent_request_id，分别统计后续响应/显示；可能换了问题，不叫同题恢复率。

source.query:
SELECT count() AS retries, countIf(c.received>0) AS response_received, countIf(c.viewed>0) AS result_viewed, countIf(c.failed>0 AND c.received=0) AS failed_without_response FROM (SELECT properties.request_id AS child, argMax(properties.parent_request_id,timestamp) AS parent FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = false AND properties.analytics_version > 1 AND coalesce(properties.$session_id, '') NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = true AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties.$session_id) AND event='ai_retry_submitted' GROUP BY child) AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT properties.request_id AS rid,
max(event='ai_query_submitted') AS submitted,
max(event='ai_response_received') AS received,
max(event='ai_result_viewed') AS viewed,
max(event='ai_cache_hit') AS cached,
max(event='ai_query_completed') AS completed,
max(event='ai_query_error' OR event='ai_query_failed') AS failed,
max(event='ai_query_rejected') AS rejected,
max(event='ai_query_blocked') AS limited,
max(event='ai_query_cancelled') AS cancelled,
argMaxIf(properties.error_code,timestamp,event IN ('ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_rejected','ai_query_blocked')) AS code
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = false AND properties.analytics_version > 1 AND coalesce(properties.$session_id, '') NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.is_test = true AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties.$session_id) AND properties.request_id IS NOT NULL AND event IN ('ai_query_submitted','ai_response_received','ai_result_viewed','ai_cache_hit','ai_query_completed','ai_query_error','ai_query_failed','ai_query_rejected','ai_query_blocked','ai_query_cancelled')
GROUP BY rid) AS c ON r.child=c.rid
